defense_news.title: General Atomics delivers FQ-42 Vengeance to Nevada air base
defense_news.summary: Creech Air Force Base received a new FQ-42 Vengeance aircraft on Friday, with the jet to continue regular test and evaluation operations.

defense_news.title: The Pentagon asked industry how fast it could make more weapons. The numbers remain private.
defense_news.summary: The Pentagon remains mum about defense contractors' plans to boost weapons production and delivery following a 21-day deadline for companies to send ideas.

defense_news.title: US watching Chinese marine presence off Alaska, Arctic Coast Guard chief says
defense_news.summary: The United States is watching China’s presence in its Arctic zone “very closely” amid increasing concerns, a senior U.S. Arctic military official said.

defense_news.title: Hegseth to chair Pentagon’s new Homeland Defense advisory board
defense_news.summary: The newly established Homeland Defense Board aims to fill a gap Pentagon leaders see in providing military guidance to homeland security missions.
